alternatives.label: Dawn Kitchen Ledger
alternatives.reason: A warm paper base, terracotta and saffron accents, and sage for delivered states give the app the feel of a handwritten kitchen ticket, while dark ink on large cream cards and tabular monospace numerals keep consume-by deadlines fast to read and WCAG AA compliant.

alternatives.label: Night Shift Clock
alternatives.reason: A deep slate-navy base keeps late-night phone use low-glare, while amber is reserved solely for deadlines and countdowns so the time-critical numerals are the only things that draw the eye, set in a bold condensed face sized for one-handed reading on a 360 px screen.

alternatives.label: Courier Handover Trail
alternatives.reason: Bone-white and pale-stone neutrals keep the screens airy and calm for kitchen-side use, a route teal traces the live status path, and marigold is reserved for handover moments, with rounded type and paired icons so status never relies on colour alone.

alternatives.label: Ledger of Meals
alternatives.reason: A muted olive, clay and warm-grey palette with a restrained deep-green accent for verified impact, paired with an editorial serif for report titles and a neutral sans for data, so the app reads as a credible ledger for sponsors and city officials rather than an urgent rescue alert.
